ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominance across ~85% of visible surface with high-contrast black framing along the trailing edges and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields in the interior of both lobes; a solid black band of varying thickness (10-40 pixels) follows the trailing edge and terminal tips; multiple discrete dark circular blobs are mapped in the mid-sections of both lobes; yellowish-brown pixel clusters are concentrated near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated convergence angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, small-amplitude serrations (sawtooth pattern) along the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated from the water-surface interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp, slightly upturned lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of several circular dark pixel clusters (3-10 pixel radius) on the white background; two prominent on the left lobe upper-quadrant and three on the right lobe center.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct gray diagonal linear streaks observed on the right lobe, oriented roughly 30 degrees from the vertical axis, breaking the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple circular pigmentation voids consistent with past parasite attachment; dark linear streaks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct yellowish-ochre biofilm or pigmentation staining concentrated around the lower central region and notch convergence.
